what: did he see a human being, and does anything say how a fight starts
his_words: I didn't see a single human being. Very strange.
I don't even know how to engage in combat and when that shit starts.

controls.detail: 73.1 ms unthrottled against 300.65 ms throttled = 4.11x. Round 6 published its timeline at 1x and PLUMBER then found the perf gate had been discarding its own phone pass since 9/5.
